sql:
-- Red Bull constructor total 2023
SELECT cs.points FROM constructor_standings cs
JOIN races r ON cs.race_id = r.race_id
WHERE cs.constructor_id = 9 AND r.year = 2023 AND r.round = (SELECT MAX(round) FROM races WHERE year = 2023)
